title: 第2章  镇天鼎
content_zh:
楚弛感觉脑袋嗡的一声炸开了，他只是用手摸了一下黑鼎，精神居然要崩溃了？
就在楚弛觉得他快死了的时候，黑鼎散发出了光芒。
光芒如日，沸腾的黑色海洋、奔涌的云龙，瞬间安静。
楚弛抬起头，再看这口鼎，发现这口鼎已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。
鼎身上的黑皮，开始剥落，露出了闪闪发光，不知名的纹路。
这些纹路，像是符文，它们挣脱鼎身，盘旋于识海上空。
其中一部分符文，冲向了楚弛的神识体。
楚弛瞳孔颤抖，脑子里多出了一些关于这口黑鼎的知识。
这口鼎，名叫镇天鼎，乃是天地诞生的无上至宝。
只是，因为此鼎太强大，被仙人一分为九。
后人称之为，镇天九鼎。
要是能集齐完整的九鼎，九鼎归一，那才是真正的镇天鼎。
哪怕天地秩序已经崩碎，也可让人轻松成仙。
“女剑仙居然将这等好东西都给了我！难道，爱上我了？”
“也对，我这样给力的男人，天下少有，哪个女人不喜欢？”
楚弛嘿嘿一笑，再次看向四周的符文。
这些符文，在他眼里，不再陌生，而是化为了文字。
“《大道自然诀》。”
“是自然者，无始之先在也……”
符文，一会在空中，一会进入楚弛的身体，隐匿于他的脑海深处。

“这好像是一门无上法诀！难道，我的妖孽人生，即将来临了，终于，轮到我崛起了吗！”
楚弛太兴奋了。
好久，这些文字才消失不见。
镇天鼎，依旧古朴，但比之前，却多出了一道无言的威压。
它屹立在识海，似乎亘古就在那里。
“剑仙姐姐，多谢了，那我走了先。你放心，我一定努力！一年后，我再喂饱你……不对，治好你！”
楚弛挥了挥手，大步离去。
“真是无知，一口烂鼎，就当做是宝贝，居然这么兴奋。他应该，在心里感激我吧。”
女剑仙微微摇头。
她丝毫不知道，她给了楚弛一个天大的造化。
如果她知道那口黑鼎，就是传说中早就失踪的镇天鼎之一，绝对会发狂。
“楚弛，珍惜这一年的时光吧，一年后，就算我没有将你采补成人干，我也不知道，我会不会亲手杀了你。
我红灵的身体，居然被一个乡野小子得到……孽缘，哎。”
“对了，我有了识海，那丹田呢？”
楚弛并不知道女剑仙的想法，他一边离开，一边将精神从识海移到了身体内部。
他的小腹，果然出现了丹田，除此之外，还有三条闪闪发光的隐脉。
三条隐脉，说明楚弛现在的修为是凡人境三层。
这个世界，修炼分为凡人境，强人境，狂人境，至人境，魔人境，地人境，天人境等境界。
每一个境界，分为九层。
“已经凡人境三层了！不知道庞妃烟那婊子见我还活着，是什么表情。”

一个时辰后，飞云村。
这里就是楚弛出生的地方。
飞云村有两大地主势力，分别是楚家和庞家。
两大势力的最强者，都是凡人境九层的修为。
这个修为，放眼整个王国，毫不起眼，卑微如蝼蚁，但在村子里，却是一方霸主。
楚弛一进村子，就引起了喧嚣。
“那不是楚家的纨绔少爷楚弛吗？我不是见鬼了吧？”
“我听说他是人人得而诛之的荒古大日体，是真的吗？”
“当然是真的，不然，怡春院二十个姑娘，怎么会被他活生生弄死了十八个。甚至，他还想对妃烟小姐的妹妹出手……真是禽兽，连未来的小姨子都不放过！”
“快，将女儿藏起来，千万不要让他看见。他要是看见女人，怕是根本控制不住自己！”
听到四周人的议论，楚弛脸色难看。
看来整个村子，都已经听过他的传说了啊！
他在跳崖的那一晚，的确在怡春院待过。
那一晚，他被庞妃烟下了最强的大补之药，醒来时候，已经在怡春院了。
当时他看见的画面，是庞妃烟正在同一个野男人苟合。
那对狗男女，将他绑成粽子，他无法动弹。
那些姑娘，不是他杀的。
是他们用狠辣的手段，捅破那些姑娘的身体，栽赃给他。
为的，就是将他塑造成为觉醒荒古大日体的邪魔！
最后，他们强行将楚弛控制，带去庞妃烟亲妹妹庞云朵的闺房，并且加大了大补之药的剂量。

只有最亲的人即将受到伤害，他们才方便出手，击杀楚弛。
但楚弛的意志比想象中的坚定，关键时刻，居然保持清醒，趁所有人不备，从窗户逃了出去。
庞家人，一路追寻，将他逼上了悬崖。
虽然当时楚家人也跟来了，但庞家家主，拿出早已经动过手脚的测阳石，强行破开楚弛的手，滴了一滴血上去。
测阳石，直接爆开了。
世人都知道，这世上只有荒古大日体，可以让测阳石裂开。
那一晚的楚弛，太绝望，太无助了。
虽然他喜欢勾搭寡妇，也是怡春院常客，但他真的是被冤枉的。
这一切，都是那婊子设的计。
止住心中的杀意，楚弛用一块布遮住了脸，快速赶回楚家。
远远的，他就看见一位女子，进入了楚家的大门。
庞妃烟！
这婊子，就算化成灰他也认得。
没想到一回来，就遇到了仇人。
庞妃烟，不是一个人来的，而是跟着庞家诸位长辈一起来的。
他们，来楚家干什么？
楚弛思考了一下，从侧墙翻入。
没多久，他听见了庞妃烟的声音。
“楚弛，今天是你的头七，明天你就下葬了。我特意来送你最后一程。如果有下辈子，我一定当你的女人……”
“这世上除了我父母外，对我最好的人就是你了。”

这娘们的话，让他好想吐！
他已经忍不住要现身，揭穿这婊子的虚伪面纱了。
“楚弛，我还记得，你为了让我提升修为，从楚家偷三色花给我。”
“你还偷了楚家姥爷，给楚枫辛苦收集的淬体水……”
庞妃烟的话，让楚家人的脸色都很难看。
原来这些东西，是被楚弛偷走的。
“楚弛，你对我的好，我都记着。如果你不是荒古大日体，那多好啊。”
“我多希望，你还活着，你要是能活着，我少活几十年又何妨？”
妈的，太假了。
实在听不下去了！
楚弛猛然一声低吼。
“婊子、恭喜你，你的愿望，成真了！”
content_en:
Chu Chi felt his head explode with a buzzing sound. He just touched the black tripod with his hand, but his spirit was about to collapse?
Just when Chu Chi thought he was about to die, the black tripod emitted light.
The light was like the sun, and the boiling black ocean and the rushing clouds and dragons were instantly quiet.
Chu Chi raised his head and looked at the cauldron again, and found that the cauldron had undergone earth-shaking changes.
The black skin on Ding's body began to peel off, revealing shiny, unknown lines.
These lines are like runes. They break away from the tripod and hover over the sea of ​​consciousness.
Some of the runes rushed towards Chu Chi's spiritual body.
Chu Chi's pupils trembled, and there was some more knowledge about this black cauldron in his mind.
This cauldron is called the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron, and it is the supreme treasure born from heaven and earth.
However, because the cauldron was too powerful, it was divided into nine parts by the immortal.
Later generations called it the Nine Cauldrons that hold the sky.
If the complete Nine Cauldrons can be gathered together and the Nine Cauldrons can be unified, then it will be the true Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron.
Even if the order of heaven and earth has collapsed, people can easily become immortals.
"The female sword fairy actually gave me all these good things! Could it be that she fell in love with me?"
"That's right. There are very few powerful men like me in the world. What woman wouldn't like him?"
Chu Chi chuckled and looked at the runes around him again.
These runes were no longer unfamiliar to him, but turned into words.
""The Natural Secret of the Great Dao"."
"It is natural, and it existed before beginning..."
The runes were in the air for a while, then entered Chu Chi's body, hiding in the depths of his mind.
"This seems to be a supreme magic! Could it be that my life as a monster is about to come? It's finally my turn to rise!"
Chu Chi was so excited.
It took a long time for these words to disappear.
The Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron is still simple, but it has an extra layer of silent pressure than before.
It stands in the sea of ​​consciousness, as if it has been there forever.
"Sister Jianxian, thank you very much. I'll leave now. Don't worry, I will work hard! I'll feed you again in a year... No, I'll cure you!"
Chu Chi waved his hand and strode away.
"It's so ignorant. He took a bad meal and treated it as a treasure, but he was so excited. He should be grateful to me in his heart."
The female sword fairy shook her head slightly.
Little did she know that she had given Chu Chi a great blessing.
If she knew that the black cauldron was one of the legendary Tianzhen cauldrons that had disappeared long ago, she would definitely go crazy.
"Chu Chi, cherish this year. After one year, even if I don't harvest you as a human being, I don't know if I will kill you with my own hands.
My Hongling body was actually obtained by a country boy... a bad fate, eh. "
"By the way, I have the sea of consciousness, but what about the Dantian?"
Chu Chi didn't know what the female sword fairy was thinking. As he left, he moved his spirit from the sea of consciousness to the inside of his body.
As expected, a Dantian appeared on his lower abdomen. In addition, there were three sparkling hidden veins.
The three hidden veins indicate that Chu Chi's current cultivation level is at the third level of the mortal realm.
In this world, cultivation is divided into realms such as the mortal realm, the strongman realm, the madman realm, the ultimate human realm, the devil realm, the earthly realm, and the heavenly realm.
Each realm is divided into nine levels.
"I'm already on the third level of the mortal realm! I don't know what that bitch Pang Feiyan's expression looked like when she saw that I was still alive."
An hour later, Feiyun Village.
This is where Chu Chi was born.
There are two major landowner forces in Feiyun Village, namely the Chu family and the Pang family.
The strongest of the two major forces are both at the ninth level of the mortal realm.
Looking at the entire kingdom, this cultivation level is insignificant and as humble as an ant, but in the village, he is the overlord.
As soon as Chu Chi entered the village, he caused a commotion.
"Isn't that Chu Chi, the dandy young master of the Chu family? Didn't I see a ghost?"
"I heard that he is the great ancient sun that everyone can kill. Is it true?"
"Of course it's true, otherwise, how could the twenty girls in Yichun Court be attracted by him?Eighteen of them were killed alive. He even wanted to take action against Miss Feiyan's sister... What a beast, he wouldn't even let go of his future sister-in-law! "
"Quickly, hide your daughter, don't let him see her. If he saw a woman, he might not be able to control himself at all! "
Chu Chi's face turned ugly when he heard the comments from people around him.
It seems that the entire village has heard his legend!
He did stay at Yichun Courtyard the night he jumped off the cliff.
That night, he was given the most powerful tonic medicine by Pang Feiyan. When he woke up, he was already in Yichun Courtyard.
The scene he saw at that time was that of Pang Feiyan having sex with a wild man.
The couple tied him into a rice dumpling and he couldn't move.
He didn't kill those girls.
It was they who used ruthless means to break the bodies of those girls and frame them for him.
The purpose is to shape him into the evil demon who awakens the ancient sun body!
Finally, they forcibly controlled Chu Chi and took her to the boudoir of Pang Feiyan's biological sister Pang Yunduo, and increased the dose of tonic medicine.
Only when their closest loved ones were about to be harmed could they take action and kill Chu Chi.
But Chu Chi's will was stronger than imagined. At the critical moment, he actually stayed awake and escaped through the window when everyone was unprepared.
The Pang family pursued him all the way and drove him to the cliff.
Although the Chu family also followed at that time, the head of the Pang family took out the sun test stone that had been tampered with before, forced open Chu Chi's hand, and dripped a drop of blood on it.
The sun test stone exploded directly.
Everyone in the world knows that only the ancient sun body in this world can make the sun test stone crack.
Chu Chi felt so desperate and helpless that night.
Although he likes to hook up with widows and is a frequent visitor to Yichun Court, he was really wronged.
All this was the plan of that bitch.
Stopping the murderous intention in his heart, Chu Chi covered his face with a piece of cloth and hurried back to Chu's house.
From a distance, he saw a woman entering the gate of the Chu family.
Pang Fei smokes!
He would recognize this bitch even if she turned into ashes.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he came back, he would meet his enemy.
Pang Feiyan did not come alone, but came with the elders of the Pang family.
What are they doing in the Chu family?
Chu Chi thought for a moment and climbed in from the side wall.
Not long after, he heard Pang Feiyan's voice.
"Chu Chi, today is your first birthday, and you will be buried tomorrow. I came here specially to see you off for the last time. If there is a next life, I will definitely be your woman..."
"Apart from my parents, the best person to me in this world is you. "
The words of this bitch made him want to vomit!
He couldn't help but show up and expose this bitch's hypocrisy.
"Chu Chi, I still remember that in order for me to improve my cultivation, you stole three-color flowers from the Chu family and gave them to me. "
"You also stole the body-tempering water that Chu family's grandpa collected so hard for Chu Feng..."
Pang Feiyan's words made the Chu family look ugly.
It turns out that these things were stolen by Chu Chi.
"Chu Chi, I will remember all your kindness to me. How great would it be if you were not the Ancient Sun? "
"How I wish you were still alive. If you could live, what would it matter if I shortened my life by a few decades? "
Damn, that’s so fake.
I really can’t listen anymore!
Chu Chi suddenly roared.
"Bitch, congratulations, your wish has come true! "
